title: Two businesses. *One network.*
intro: A 15-second commercial for Little & Holland and a 30-second commercial for your rental car business — each custom-built by MCTV and played full-screen, on repeat, inside the venues your customers already visit. Unskippable. Unblockable.
traffic_note: Option 4 adds sponsorship of MCTV's Oxford traffic updates, credited to the business of your choice.
footprint_note: Oxford / Lafayette has 44 host venues, so 20 or 40 screens can stay in Oxford; the 80-screen plans add Tupelo and Golden Triangle screens. We confirm your exact screen list before launch.
compliance_line: Little & Holland approves its final commercial and handles any required Mississippi Bar filing before it airs.
